title: Python: implement real Yggdrasil AddrForKey algorithm
description:
Replace yggdrasil_address() in python/src/lichen/crypto/identity.py with exact Yggdrasil algorithm:
1. Invert pubkey bits (buf = ~pubkey)
2. Count leading 1-bits in buf
3. Build address: 0x02 prefix, 7-bit ones count, stripped inverted key bits

Reference: yggdrasil-go/src/address/address.go AddrForKey()
Breaking change: all derived addresses will differ.
Update _NATIVE_MESH_PREFIX to 0200::/7 in node.py.
Regenerate test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json with new algorithm.
